endorsements.name: David Rook
endorsements.label: The security risks of Web 2.0
endorsements.description: Web 2.0 technologies are changing the landscape of the Internet by delivering significant increases in the functionality of websites and providing a more interactive experience to the user. This rapid proliferation of new technologies is also accompanied by new attack vectors that hackers are eager to exploit. I will detail the security risks introduced by web 2.0 and how you can prevent them.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 17
